import json, subprocess, sys, os, tempfile
MAIN = "/app/submission/main.py"
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/workspace/tmp")
def run(cfg, reqs):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "compile"], input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stdout
    prog = os.path.join(d, "p.json"); open(prog, "wb").write(p.stdout)
    pr = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN, "stream", prog], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=d)
    out = []
    for r in reqs:
        pr.stdin.write(json.dumps(r).encode() + b"\n"); pr.stdin.flush(); out.append(json.loads(pr.stdout.readline()))
    pr.stdin.close(); assert pr.wait() == 0
    return out

cfg = {"version": 1, "idle_timeout": 10, "packet_limit": 5, "prefix_width": 2,
       "rules": [{"id": 7, "class": 2, "priority": 10, "ranges": [[100, 105], [-60, -60]]}], "fallback": FB}

# A: idle boundary (exactly at timeout does nothing), then idle, then close
o = run(cfg, [{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0}, {"op": "tick", "time": 10},
              {"op": "tick", "time": 11}, {"op": "close", "flow": 1, "time": 11}])
exp = [{"events": []}, {"events": []},
       {"events": [{"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 8, "reason": "idle", "at": 0, "time": 11, "rule": None}]},
       {"events": [{"type": "closed", "flow": 1, "packets": 0, "matches": 0, "class": 8, "reason": "idle", "rule": None}]}]
print("A", "PASS" if o == exp else "FAIL " + json.dumps(o))

# A2: idle fires before the packet of the very chunk that would match; matches still audited

              {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 1, "length": 102}]},
              {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 1, "time": 20, "source": 0, "length": 60}]},
              {"op": "close", "flow": 1, "time": 20}])

print("A2", "PASS" if o == exp else "FAIL " + json.dumps(o))
